summary.one_liner: SpotSpot is a Spotify mini-player for macOS, now unmaintained by its author, who points to Lofi as a replacement.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SpotSpot as a Spotify mini-player for macOS, per the listing. It is no longer maintained, and the author says they no longer use it. The README gives no feature list, screenshots, or usage instructions beyond development setup. Its only documented commands are for cloning the repo, installing dependencies with yarn, starting the app, and packaging it. The README names Lofi as a more feature-rich alternative.
use_cases: control spotify playback from a small macos window
reference a discontinued spotify desktop controller
notable: Author has stopped maintaining it and recommends Lofi instead
Packaging is handled through a yarn script
caveats: No longer maintained by the author
Author recommends Lofi as a more feature-rich alternative
macOS only, per the listing description
